claims.country: India is listed under limited products rather than the restricted Forex and Crypto countries.
claims.productLimit: E8 Pro and E8 Signature are available at all sizes; E8 One is capped at $50,000 for India.
claims.providerGate: Payout availability also depends on WorkMarket or Rise onboarding.

claims.checkout: Major credit cards, bank cards, and cryptocurrency are published purchase methods.
claims.cryptoFee: E8 tells buyers to account for network fees on crypto purchases.

claims.kyc: Veriff accepts passport, ID card, driving licence, or residence permit.
claims.review: A post-challenge manual KYC review is normally completed within 24 hours.

claims.payout: WorkMarket provides bank transfers and Rise provides cash or cryptocurrency options.
claims.fee: E8 charges no payout commission, but its providers may charge method-dependent fees.
claims.minimum: The published minimum payout request is $100.
